 def build_order(deps: Mapping[str, Iterable[str]]) -> list[str]:
     """Order the targets so that dependencies come first. See README.md for the rules."""
-    raise NotImplementedError
+
+    all_names: set[str] = set(deps)
+    for dep_list in deps.values():
+        all_names.update(dep_list)
+
+    dependents: dict[str, set[str]] = {n: set() for n in all_names}
+    dependencies: dict[str, set[str]] = {n: set() for n in all_names}
+
+    for target, needed_list in deps.items():
+        for needed in needed_list:
+            dependencies[target].add(needed)
+            dependents[needed].add(target)
+
+    ready = [n for n in all_names if not dependencies[n]]
+    ready.sort()
+    order: list[str] = []
+    finished: set[str] = set()
+
+    while ready:
+        node = ready.pop(0)
+        order.append(node)
+        finished.add(node)
+        for dep in dependents[node]:
+            if dep in dependencies:
+                dependencies[dep].discard(node)
+                if not dependencies[dep]:
+                    ready.append(dep)
+        ready.sort()
+
+    unresolved = all_names - finished
+    if unresolved:
+        _detect_cycle(deps, all_names, finished)
+
+    return order
+
+
+def _detect_cycle(
+    deps: Mapping[str, Iterable[str]],
+    all_names: set[str],
+    finished: set[str],
+) -> None:
+    names = sorted(all_names - finished)
+    unvisited: set[str] = set(names)
+
